column4: developer tool run by hand on a Linux test host (run-dmflakey-pg.sh / soak.sh): initdb's a throwaway PostgreSQL cluster on a dm-flakey filesystem, commits acknowledged Keyorix audit events through the production storage factory (storage.type: postgres, audit_durability: strict), cuts power with dm-flakey drop_writes + force unmount, restarts postgres (WAL replay) and checks every acknowledged-before-cut commit survived, the audit hash chain verifies, pg_amcheck and e2fsck are clean; never linked into a shipped binary, no auth decisions, fixed powercut.commit events used only to be counted
